existingPinnedSourceBindings.fact: The public dashboard branch emits HERMES_DASHBOARD_READY port=<bound-port> to stdout after the server binds. The probe reads this sentinel only from its owned child's stdout.
The dashboard command defaults to headless_backend=false; `serve` alone sets it true. The real `hermes dashboard` child therefore follows the dashboard sentinel branch.
Existing profile-scoped OAuth routes return a fixed sanitized HTTP 400 after the registered profile auth save failure. The product patch is unchanged.

evidence: Real pinned public dashboard child, child-reported PID matches the owned process handle, and child-reported parent PID/UID/GID match this probe process.
The readiness sentinel provides the bound port used only with 127.0.0.1; start and poll use redirect:error.
Synthetic device grant reaches approved and exactly one device request, poll and token exchange are recorded with no denials.
Only success-profile auth changes; root and toy-profile auth/environment stores retain their digest.
Fresh public auth list reads the saved grant.
Fresh public tools-disabled chat uses the initial synthetic generation, reaches the fake model, and has no fallback or denied HTTP.
Root and opposite toy-profile stores remain byte-identical; success-profile metadata may change during use.
Registered profile-auth-atomic-replace-eio fires after the fake token response on profiles/toy/auth.json.
The public poll returns HTTP 400 with exactly the fixed sanitized detail and no success/approved claim.
Every observed start/poll response is restricted to the existing public field allowlists and scanned for token keys, JWT-shaped data, and synthetic access/refresh/authorization-code material.
Fresh auth list is empty; fresh tools-disabled chat is unusable and its HTTP ledger is all zero.
Root and success-profile stores remain byte-identical; no raw response body, session token, session ID, child stream or credential is written to evidence.
